raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 1, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the 58th quadrennial U.S. presidential election as 2020 and misinterpreted “held after the 2016 Michigan Democratic primary”; the 58th election was the 2016 United States presidential election, which occurred after the March 8, 2016 primary.
